summary: CAE Inc. (NYSE: CAE) announces regulatory approval to renew its normal course issuer bid (NCIB) to repurchase up to 16,073,033 common shares (5% of outstanding) for cancellation over a one-year period starting June 10, 2026. No price per share is fixed; purchases will be made at market prices through the TSX, NYSE, or off-exchange block transactions. TD Securities acts as designated broker under an automatic repurchase plan. Prior bid (June 2025–June 2026) saw 565,259 shares bought at a VWAP of $35.4418. The NCIB represents a capital-return program, not a formal tender offer. Watch for actual repurchase pace and market conditions affecting execution.
